newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Killer of leftist politician flees Colombian jail.
newsitem.headline: Killer of leftist politician flees Colombian jail.

text.p: A Colombian gunman jailed for the murder of a prominent leftist politician has disappeared after being released from prison on a three-day parole, authorities said on Wednesday.
Police and prison officials said Beller Yesid Barrera, who was serving a 24-year sentence, was released from Bogota's La Picota prison on conditional parole last week.
He was under strict orders to return by Friday but failed to do so and his whereabouts are unknown, the officials said.

Barrera was convicted for his role in the 1987 killing of Jaime Pardo Leal, a leader of the left-wing Patriotic Union Party who was gunned down on orders from late Medellin cartel drug boss Gonzalo Rodriguez Gacha.
William Infante, another contract killer convicted in connection with Pardo Leal's assassination, was killed in the maximum security wing of La Picota on March 29 when a bomb exploded in his cell.

Spokesmen for the Patriotic Union Party -- which has often been described as the political arm of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia rebel group -- say at least 3,000 party members died at the hands of right-wing gunmen between 1985 and 1990.
